sources.title: Peloton cuts 11% of staff in cost-cutting push, spokesperson says
sources.description: Peloton Interactive (PTON.O) has cut 11 per cent of its employees as it aims to reduce costs amid turnaround efforts, a spokesperson for the company said on Friday.
